meta.name: paper-search-usage
meta.description: This skill should be used when user asks to "search for papers", "find research papers", "search arXiv", "search PubMed", "find academic papers", "search IEEE", "search Scopus", or "look up scientific literature".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索并查找学术论文与科学文献
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速查找学术论文或科学文献
copy.tagline_en: Search and find academic papers and scientific literature
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly find academic papers or scientific literature

howto.what: 装上后,当你要找论文时,Claude会调用学术论文搜索工具,在arXiv、PubMed等平台按关键词、作者或主题检索,并给出结果。
howto.when: 当你说“搜论文”“找研究论文”“搜arXiv”等,或要求查找学术文献、搜索IEEE/Scopus时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索一下关于Transformer的arXiv论文
say.note: 会调用工具在arXiv检索相关预印本

say.text: 在PubMed上找找关于高血压的最新研究
say.note: 将定向搜索PubMed生物医学库

say.text: 查一下作者Yann LeCun的学术文章
say.note: 按作者姓名检索多个平台

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will use paper-search tools to search academic papers on platforms like arXiv and PubMed by keywords, authors, or topics, and present the results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "search for papers", "find research papers", "search arXiv", etc., or ask to look up scientific literature.

say_en.text: Find recent studies on hypertension in PubMed.
Look up academic articles by author Yann LeCun.
